$comment: CHANDRASITE shared data contract v0.1 — agree changes with Vaishali and Anika before editing. Every pipeline stage writes into this shape; the dashboard (app.py) only reads it.

ice_deposits.area_m2: float — estimated surface area in square meters
ice_deposits.dop_mean: float — mean degree of polarization (supporting radar metric)

landing_site.coordinates: [lat, lon] — proposed landing coordinates in degrees
landing_site.halo_risk: bool — true if within crater-rim illumination halo risk zone

rover_path.total_distance_m: float — total traverse distance in meters
rover_path.battery_at_rim_pct: float — predicted battery percentage on return to rim
rover_path.charging_waypoint: [lat, lon] — location of solar/RHU charging stop
